verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Your blood that stained the ground
Is where my hope is found
Your scars caused by my sin
Is where my life begins

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
My heart can not contain
This joy bought by Your pain
Such grace I can't repay
Still I give my everything

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
How great is your love
How great is Your love for me
How great is your love
How great is Your love for me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
So high, so deep, so great that its overwhelming
So high, so deep, so great is Your love, Your love for me
